corrections.title: Withdrawn: Penicillin G PLI link to MNRE

originalEdge.d: PLI subsidy selection — 48h before Aurobindo's ₹25cr bond to BJP.

officialSource.title: Approval accorded under PLI Scheme for Promotion of Domestic Manufacturing of critical Key Starting Materials (KSMs)/ Drug Intermediates and APIs
officialSource.publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
officialSource.locator: Approved-applicant table, row 1, and paragraph identifying the Department of Pharmaceuticals

corrections.rationale: The bulk-drug PLI is administered by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, not MNRE. The official 22 January 2021 release already names Aurobindo Pharma through Lyfius Pharma for Penicillin G. The opened 12 April 2024 Reporters' Collective article attributes a 6 November 2023 listing/approval, but this does not establish first approval. The original graph also ran from company to MNRE while calling the relation an award. Remove the incorrect award from traversal; retain this correction card at the old saved-record ID. No replacement award or payment is inferred.
limitations: The correction does not decide whether a later approval, amendment or listing had distinct financial consequences.
The official release describes company commitments and a scheme ceiling, not a verified subsidy cash payment to this company.
The old 90-day motif combined November 2022 and November 2023 donations and therefore did not demonstrate its stated interval.

officialSource.title: SEC Files Proposed Final Judgments Against Gautam Adani and Sagar Adani

historicalAmendments.rationale: The official release says proposed judgments, subject to court approval. It does not establish entry or payment. Node summaries and all six affected Atlas source lines are corrected; existing relationship/record IDs are preserved.
